method: Make the filling first. Get the pan properly hot, add the chickpeas, drained and let it take on a little colour before you start moving it around.

Keep the lettuce, tomato and other fresh/crunchy ingredients out of the pan. Season the chickpeas, drained with the measured flavourings and keep the fresh ingredients fresh; there is no sauce reduction step to invent here.
Warm the wrap, then layer the filling through the centre with the fresh/crunchy elements last. Do not overfill it just because you can.
